why.org_c:finding:06379: Critical internet-facing vulnerability (CVE-2024-21762, KEV) providing an active initial entry vector directly onto a crown-jewel attack path.
why.org_c:finding:06380: Privilege escalation vulnerability on the compromised VPN host enabling lateral movement to secrets and crown jewels.
why.org_c:finding:06378: Internet-facing vulnerability on amber-willow-vpn-43 participating in an alternate crown-jewel attack path.
why.org_c:finding:06381: Internet-facing vulnerability on vireo-sol-vpn-45 enabling an attack path to the warehouse data store.
why.org_c:finding:06376: Internet-facing vulnerability on onyx-vane-vpn-42 that forms part of the minimum cut set disconnecting external access.
why.org_c:finding:06404: Internet-facing vulnerability on swift-meadow-vpn-48 contributing to an alternative attack path toward the crown jewels.
why.org_c:finding:06377: Internal vulnerability facilitating lateral movement along the crown-jewel path.
why.org_c:finding:06382: Internal remote service vulnerability enabling secondary hops within the attack path.
why.org_c:finding:06405: Internal service vulnerability allowing lateral progression toward database credentials.

reasoning: We prioritize findings that actively lie on attack paths leading from the Internet to the crown-jewel warehouse data store. The min_cut tool identifies five specific internet-facing findings whose remediation completely disconnects external attacker access from the crown jewels. Addressing these entries neutralizes all primary and secondary avenues of exploitation.
